_help: Region keywords, matched case-insensitively on each headline + excerpt. The first region in 'order' that matches wins, so Libya beats MENA; anything unmatched is Global.
en: whole words (a trailing plural 's' is allowed, so 'Saudi' also matches 'Saudis'). Multi-word terms match across any whitespace.
en_exclude: phrases removed before matching, e.g. 'Gulf of Mexico' must not count as the Gulf.
ar_words: written WITHOUT the article (ال). Each may carry one attached prefix from ar_prefixes and one suffix from ar_suffixes.
ar_stems: like ar_words, but a suffix is REQUIRED (the bare stem is not a word), e.g. ليب -> ليبي / ليبية / الليبيين.
Arabic is normalised before matching: diacritics and tatweel removed, and أ إ آ written as ا. Write terms with plain ا.
A term only matches when the letters before and after it are not Arabic letters (\b does not work for Arabic).
